batting.name: KR Mayers
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b MM Ali

batting.name: KH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b M Theekshana

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c MM Ali b M Pathirana

batting.name: K Gowtham
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b M Pathirana

balls.text: Badoni will continue to wait at the non-striker's end- because Gowtham has holed out to long on. Length ball on off that Gowtham tried to drag over cow corner. Went high up for a simple catch

Badoni will have to wait because it is a dot and could also be a wicket. Fullish ball outside off and Gowtham swung his bat hard at it with minimal footwork. It perhaps took an edge to the keeper but may have fallen short of MS. The umpires want to check. No edge, replays say

what a way to end the over! Chahar proves expensive at the death again A score of 126 was enough few nights ago here and now LSG have touched 125. Chahar went full outside off, forcing Badoni to hit through the big side but the pocket rocket moves to the off side and thumps a loft over extra cover. Remember DK in the Nidahas Trophy final? That.
short ball, wider outside off. Flat-batted to wide long on, and enough time to return for two.
takes pace off. Length ball, fourth-stump line. Badoni swings across the line but gets a toe-end to the off side
fifty in style.... and what a spunky innings from the 23 year old! Good length ball, fourth-stump line. Badoni holds his shape and pulls in front of square. Blows a kiss to the crowd
over the keeper and four! Chahar goes short, Badoni attempts the pull, but he's through the shot too early. Got a top edge.
Chahar to bowl at the death. Short length ball outside off and he powerfully flat-bats it past the bowler to long on

another yorker length ball just outside off stump. Badoni digs it away to the off side and they take a single. Umpire Chaudhary talks to Badoni and gives him a 'first warning'. My guess is that this is for running straight down the pitch`
almost a yorker. Lands in front of his toes. Soft-hand bunt to the leg side and they take off for one

Pooran gone for a 31-ball 20 having failed to clear cover this time. This was full outside off and the drive didn't have the elevation to beat the infielder. Timing also average. Story of his innings.

short ball, fourth-stump line. Badoni drags a pull from outside off but gets it in the gap at cow corner. However, this time Jadeja sprints across the boundary line and throws his body towards the ball to stop it. Terrific
short length ball around off and he flat-bats this mistimed shot to long on. Team hundred
short and wide. Badoni crunches a cut that had four written all over it, except for Devon Conway's stunning dive at point to stop the boundary
length ball, very wide outside off. He stretches out to cut but gets a bottom edge that then goes through Dhoni's legs. Some more runs, in fact three more! Theekshana ends with 2-37
full ball on middle and driven to long off for a single
full ball on off. Swings across the line but mistimes to long on. Crucial 50-run partnership in 44 balls

turning away and cut past point! Full ball, very wide and turning further away from Badoni. A big slash in that shot from Badoni, getting some extra power behind that shot. Jadeja's dive not good enough in the deep
fullish ball, quite wide outside off. Badoni will be disappointed that the cut went straight to the point fielder

27 runs off the last 2.1 overs! Theekshana bowled full on middle, and Badoni got down on one knee to repeat that slog sweep. This one is a better connection, and clears the short boundary at midwicket with ease
yorker attempted, very nearly successful. Very low full toss aimed at his shin, and he gets it down to long on for a single
wayward, very wayward and this is five wides. Sprays this wide down leg, and even the great MS Dhoni had no chance
fullish ball on middle and Pooran gets this down to long off for a single
full ball on middle. Pooran drives it right back to Pathirana, who does an excellent job getting low to intercept
fullish ball outside off. Driven to mid off's left
short ball attempted, too short in fact. The square umpire did not signal it, but the front-on umpire did.
full ball on off and Pooran looks to tee off. Aims for wide long on but the ball flies away to deep square leg instead
overpitched ball outside off, and landing beyond the batter. Had Pooran got bat to it, that was a juicy full toss
faster one to end the over. Overpitched around off and driven to deep point where Jadeja is operating. They take on the arm and get two
good length ball outside leg. Comfortably nudged off his waist to square leg. Pooran yet to hit a boundary...
full ball around leg and he eases into a drive to mid on
almost a yorker around leg stump. Badoni squirts the ball away somehow to backward point for one
pings it well! Full just outside off. Gets low and brings out the slog sweep. Flat over cow corner
full ball around off and middle. Pushed to mid off for a single
yorker length just outside off stump. Pooran does well to dig the ball out and also give it some direction. Towards deep point. Another time out
full ball, wider outside off. Badoni drives away from his body and gets a shot away to cover
yorker, just outside off. Badoni tried to dig it out but failed to. Through to MS
good length ball around off. Pooran guides this to backward point for a walking single
full ball outside off stump and he gets low to play the square drive. There's protection in the deep
And here's the slingerman. Full ball on off stump and driven to cover's right for one
skiddy full ball around off stump. Badoni fends off the back foot. Confidently
length ball outside off and he punches in front of square, forcing Conway to give the ball a big chase on the bigger boundary side
around the stumps. Fullish ball around off and angling into off stump.  Pooran punches off the back foot to the bowler
good length ball around off. Badoni punches to long on for a single
just short of short fine leg! Badoni tried to play the paddle after moving to the off side. But the ball hit the high part of his bat. Very nearly to Pathirana
that's been hit towards deep extra cover for a single
flatter. Length on off and Pooran gets down on one knee. Pulls to deep midwicket. Moeen done with four overs: 2-13
full ball on off. Ball straightens after pitching. Tapped behind square on the off side. They don't take the single
full ball outside off. Badoni gives the bat a big wind up but the cut goes to deep point only
fullish ball outside off. Driven with the turn to long off
around the stumps. Fullish ball just outside off. Pooran poked at it like Krunal, and the ball got the edge. Lands just short of Rahane at first slip
good length ball, quite wide outside off but turning into middle. Punched to mid on
good length ball around off, and tapped towards backward point
full ball just outside off and pushed to deep point
full ball outside off and defended after getting low
good length ball around off. Pooran nurdles it from close to his body to short third
full ball outside off. Sticks the bat out and gets the ball towards point
length ball around middle. He rocks back and pulls in front of square. Protection in the deep though
full ball just outside off. Badoni fends it after getting behind the ball's line
full ball outside off. Bit of turn in. Fended

...and this sticks! Full ball around off and Karan got forward to hammer this with some high velocity. But Moeen sticks his hands up and the ball is in his grasp! Even MS Dhoni is impressed from behind the stumps. A second one for Moeen
around the stumps. Fullish outside off. Bit of turn away. Guided to point
good length ball around off. Turning into leg and flicked to deep square leg
full ball outside off but big turn into him. Steps forward to flick, hits the pad. Appeal turned down. Probably sliding down leg
good length ball around off. Sharma nurdles it to the left of short cover for a single. Strategic Time Out/Drinks Break
fullish ball around off. Pooran goes onto the back foot, gently taps it to the off side, and calls quickly for a single
full ball on middle and he drives confidently past short cover's right. Long off has some running around to do
fullish ball outside off. Guides a shot to backward point for one
full, slower this time. Lands just outside off. Bunted back to Jadeja
full around off and he slaps this straight back. But Jadeja moves to his left to stop it
only four singles in that over. Length ball around middle that Pooran clipped off the back foot to fine leg
full ball around middle and leg. Worked with the turn to short fine leg
full all around leg, and he drives to long off for a single
around the stumps. Full around middle. Defended to the off side. Moeen runs forward, ending any thought of a possible single
full ball on off. Sharp turn into leg stump. Worked off his pads to square leg
full ball around off stump. Sharma taps it to the leg side
full on middle, and clipped to square leg. No run

flight, turn, and bowled! Jadeja bowled fullish outside leg. Stoinis didn't expect it to turn a lot, so brought the bat down for a straight drive. But he's shocked to hear the stumps get rattled, and looks back to see that the ball turned all the way across to knock off stump back. Incredible.
good length ball outside off. Stands tall and plays a more confident punch past cover. Shouts of "catch, catch" from the bowler there
terrific delivery. Length ball around middle and off. Turning across to off, surprising Stoinis who let it go
good length ball outside off again. Cut to deep point, and the fielder runs in to keep it down to a single
Jadeja around the stumps. Length ball outside off. Slaps a cut behind point
no drama from Stoinis. Steps across to the off side and brings out the sweep shot to this full ball. Races away behind square. Powerplay done: LSG 31 for 3

and straight to slip! Rahane scoops this up from way down low after Krunal poked at it. This was full-ish outside off, tempting Krunal to feel bat on ball. The plan has worked magnificently with replays showing Rahane's fingers under the ball holding on to a real grubber. Golden duck for KP, Theekshana on a hat-trick

no need to review that! Theekshana stays on a stump-to-stump line. Vohra tries to move across in a bid to access the backward square region. The ball hurries onto him, and the leg stump is knocked back.

full ball around off and skidding straight through. Vohra moves to the off side and tries to paddle it behind square, but misses. Hits the front leg and Theekshana appeals for lbw. Umpire Anil says no. They choose not to review. Maybe hitting him outside off
good length ball around off. Karan guides it to the leg side for a quick single
good length ball outside off. Turning into Vohra and getting big on him. He is forced to go back and pull uncomfortably to wide long on
keeper standing up to stop Vohra from coming down the track. Fullish on middle,  and flicked to deep square leg for a single
good length ball, fourth-stump line. Vohra gets forward to punch it past Chahar, but the ball takes an inside edge

full ball just outside off. Vohra comes dancing down the track, and the flick is played in front of square, getting it past midwicket. Theekshana gives it a chase but not to be. 3000+ runs in T20s for Vohra
short and wide. Karan goes for the cut but his timing isn't sweet. Ball goes to deep point
left alone. Length ball outside off

leading edge, chance for first slip! Chahar's fullish ball on middle squared Karan up. He tried to flick it leg side but the ball moved across him late and took the leading edge. First slip is a metre short driving to his right
full on off stump. Tucked to the leg side behind square for one
Moeen over the stumps. Full around off and he comes down the ground to drive to mid on

Moeen does the season double over Mayers! Gets him both times in the league stage. Full ball outside off. Just a bit of turn away with Mayers looking to go big down the ground. Ball went high up, and Gaikwad ran in from long off to seal the deal. Kisses the ball too. Oh, how good it is to be in a post Covid world.
full ball around middle. Clipped off his toes to square leg for a single
good length ball on middle. Mayers backs away and punches off the back foot to point
full around leg and skidding down leg further. Hits Mayers' pad
short ball, pace off this time at only 120kph. Pulled to Conway in the deep
past the outside edge. Mayers may have gotten carried away, trying to drive Chahar again. This time the full ball outside off whizzes past the outside edge
mid-off's dive is futile! Chahar went full outside off and Mayers clubbed a drive down the V. Theekshana with the dive but can't get a hand to it
that's gone high up but lands safe on the leg side (the bigger side today). Chahar went short and Mayers pulled it up, meeting the ball from low to high
full ball on middle and swinging into his pads. Mayers gets enough behind a swipe across his pads, and the ball dribbles away to deep square leg
good length ball, fifth-stump line. Vohra gets on top of the ball and cuts to deep point
full ball on off and Mayers attempts the drive. It takes the outside edge and goes along the ground to Jadeja at short third. Just one off the over.
full ball around off. Mayers sticks the bat in front and lets the ball meet it. Knocked away to point
good length ball around off. Tiptoes and punches smartly. Finds cover though
back of a length on middle and this one shapes into Mayers after pitching. Fended from in front of his chest
length ball just outside off and he punches a drive to mid off. Calls early for the single, and off they go
length ball outside off and cut towards point
Mayers ruins the over for Chahar as this short ball is angling across the batter. Mayers crunches a cut through the gap.
swinging full toss outside off. Caressed to cover.
beautiful delivery. Full on middle. And swinging away from Mayers with the batter pressing forward tentatively. Past the outside edge!
full outside off and this is the one that goes away from the left-hander. Mayers misses the drive. Through to the keeper
length ball around off and shaping into middle. Mayers inside edges a defensive shot onto his pads
length ball around leg stump, and comfortably worked to fine leg for one.
